text: In the linearized (cascade) analysis, each successive DeepESN layer acts on the layer below as what kind of filter?
choices: A high-pass filter that removes slow trends
A band-pass filter centered on the fast oscillation
A low-pass filter with a progressively lower cutoff frequency
An all-pass filter that changes only phase, not magnitude
explanation: Each leaky layer is a first-order IIR low-pass filter with cutoff ω_c ≈ α(1−ρ); stacking them forms a cascade whose composite cutoff drops with depth, so upper layers see only low-frequency content. A high-pass or band-pass filter (options 0, 1) would suppress the slow envelope the top layer is meant to preserve; an all-pass filter (option 3) would not perform the temporal integration at all.
